title: eremophila decipiens subsp. linearifolia
intro: Eremophila decipiens subsp. linearifolia, commonly known as Desert Emu Bush, is a flowering plant native to Western Australia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including coughs, colds, and skin problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can aid in wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of Eremophila decipiens subsp. linearifolia include diterpenoid lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
